## Repository coherence

- [ ] Branch compared with current `main`
- [ ] Branch synchronized with current `main` where overlapping changes require it
- [ ] Shared/global documentation checked semantically, not only for merge conflicts
- [ ] No older branch document overwrites a newer Accepted decision
- [ ] Existing ADRs/product/architecture decisions reviewed before introducing competing conventions
- [ ] Approved PRE-SCOPE/write gate matches the physical paths changed, when the workstream requires one

## Validation

- [ ] Tests/validation added or updated when applicable
- [ ] Relevant durable documentation reviewed/updated
- [ ] Active workstream handoff updated
- [ ] `docs/PROJECT-STATUS.md` updated only if global state changed
- [ ] ADR added/updated if this changes a durable architectural decision
- [ ] Migration/rollback impact considered when persistence changes
- [ ] DEV/UAT/PROD impact noted when deployment behavior changes
- [ ] No secrets or personal production data committed
- [ ] Web/mobile/API compatibility considered where applicable
- [ ] Required repository/CI checks that actually exist are passing

## Main-branch safety

- [ ] Integration is through a pull request; no unapproved direct `main` write
- [ ] No force-push/shared-history rewrite used for cosmetic cleanup
- [ ] Review conversations that materially block correctness/coherence are resolved
- [ ] New required status checks were not invented before their workflows/check contexts exist and are stable

Repository safety policy: `docs/development/repository-engineering-safety.md`.
